_note: Corrected passive text for items the scrape mangled, applied OVER data/items.json at load by web/advisor/itemmeta.py. The prompt tells the model the item description is the factual source, so an item whose text is garbled is the one being described worst. Kept outside items.json on purpose: that file is regenerated by the scraper and would eat any edit made directly to it.
_provenance: Each entry records where the correct wording came from. Nothing here is invented -- if the real text is not known, the mangled version stays, because a plausible guess in the factual source is worse than obvious damage.

passives: Lightshield Strike: The first attack against an enemy champion Critically Strikes (6s cooldown per target), dealing 160% damage and restoring Health equal to 125% of base Attack Damage [ad] + 6% of your missing Health [hp].
sundered-sky._was: Lightshield Strike: The first attack against an enemy champion deals Critically Strikes (6s cooldown per target), dealing 160% damage and restores Health (equal to 125% base Attack Damage [ad] + 6% of missing Health [hp] to you.
sundered-sky._why: The scrape dropped the close of the heal clause, leaving an unbalanced bracket and a sentence that stops mid-formula, and garbled 'Critically Strikes' into 'deals Critically Strikes'. Every NUMBER survived intact, so this is a readability fix rather than a correctness one -- the model was already reasoning from 160% damage, 125% base AD and 6% missing Health.
